query: INSERT INTO user_challenges (user_id, challenge_id) SELECT $1, $2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_challenges uc JOIN challenges c ON c.id = uc.challenge_id WHERE uc.user_id = $1 AND c.ends_at > NOW() AND uc.finished = false) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM challenges WHERE id = $2 AND starts_at <= NOW() AND NOW() <= ends_at) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING *;
